selection: Fixed four nonreserved development representatives chosen before this pilot; no score-based symbol selection
priceSource: Frozen normalized hourly quotes only; no daily provider OHLC used to build pilot features

dailyPolicy.crypto: 24 exact UTC hourly sources; completion at next UTC midnight; any missing/invalid hour excludes daily candle
dailyPolicy.stock: Approved exchange session, exact hourly starts: seven sources normally, four for verified 13:00 early close; conservative daily completion at 17:00 Eastern
dailyPolicy.ohlc: first open, max high, min low, last close; volume sum only when all source volumes finite and nonnegative, otherwise null
dailyPolicy.volumeCaveat: Additive volume semantics are an unverified provider assumption, particularly for crypto; not a validated training feature

executionPolicy: Same hourly source; 4H grouping for crypto; four-plus-three-source stock sessions and a single four-source short session; daily completeness is not used to erase earlier complete 4H bars
gapPolicy: Missing/invalid scheduled daily sources or split events reset the 250-daily-bar feature state; holidays/weekends are not gaps. No reset based on disagreement with a second daily-price feed. This is a documented source design amendment, not verification of hourly quote authority.
features: Original causal feature formulas, 250 daily warmup, 5-minute availability delay and completed-week policy unchanged; restrict outputs to pre-April development decisions
splitPolicy: Use original V2 decision windows and 75-day fitting embargo as feasibility boundaries; feature counts are upper bounds, not resolved fitting samples
comparisons: frozen original feature availability for the same four symbols
optimistic no-missing-source 250-bar warmup ceiling on the same two-year history
readiness: First test complete-source quality and usable history; no model fit unless a later readiness assessment passes
